verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost the same and both are broken. In each one the photo has shrunk to a small, washed-out strip floating in the middle. The headline is small and pushed to the right, with no yellow underline bars behind its lines. The yellow bars and the dots (now tiny and barely visible) are scattered around the lower half with no clear purpose. Large empty white areas sit between the elements, so the layout reads as fragments instead of a designed poster. The only difference is the beige circle at the top: B's is larger and fills the empty top a little better, while A's is smaller and leaves the top even emptier.
